name: smwmusic-shovel-knight-mole-knight-battle
title: Shovel Knight - Mole Knight Battle
description:
One of my favorite battle tunes from Shovel Knight. Very intense and fast paced with a wild synth solo. Also one of the hardest ports I have ever done; It took approx 5 days of exhausting work.

This was my entry for SMWC Idol 9 round 3. At the time AddmusicK had a ton of trouble with slowdown on this port. But now that amk 1.0.7 is out and improves slowdown quite a bit, I decided to optimize this and release it.
